arguments.command:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/timeit.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
start=$(date +%s.%N)
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.deps:/workspace/submission python3 -B /workspace/submission/main.py < "$1" > "$2" 2>/tmp/err.txt
rc=$?
end=$(date +%s.%N)
echo "exit=$rc time=$(echo "$end - $start" | bc) out_bytes=$(stat -c%s "$2")"
head -c 300 /tmp/err.txt
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/timeit.sh && /tmp/timeit.sh /tmp/max_0_route.json /tmp/maxout.json
